changelog:
- Major change: Skill reworked to search and sort one-way flights using Ctrip mobile results (abandoning previous Google Flights workflow).
- Accepts Chinese city names or 3-letter city/airport codes; requires date in YYYY-MM-DD format.
- New Python script (`search_ctrip_flights.py`) handles API calls and formatting.
- Results display flight number, departure/arrival time, price, and transfer status; sorted by price ascending.
- Removed legacy files related to Google Flights and CLI interface.
- Strict new input/output rules to match Chinese-language Telegram usage and prevent invented data.
summary: Search one-way flight options by departure city, destination city, and date using Ctrip mobile results, then sort by price ascending. Use when the user wants...
